```artifact
Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management

  Scenario: Provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I create a new section with the title "Section 1"
    Then the section should have a unique and permanent identifier

  Scenario: Support formatting within linkable text
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I create a new section with the title "Section 1" and the content "This is **bold** and *italic*"
    Then the section content should be formatted as bold and italic

  Scenario: Support the storage of external requirements assets
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I upload a file named "external_requirements.txt"
    Then the file should be stored in the project and accessible

  Scenario: Import content from other requirements management tools
    Given a new Doorstop project
    When I import content from a CSV file
    Then the content should be successfully imported into the project

  Scenario: Export content to interact with common text/document tools
    Given a Doorstop project with content
    When I export the content to a Markdown file
    Then the content should be exported in Markdown format

  Scenario: View requirements as a document
    Given a Doorstop project with content
    When I generate a document from the project
    Then the document should contain all the requirements in a structured format

  Scenario: View document items interactively
    Given a Doorstop project with content
    When I open the project in interactive mode
    Then I should be able to view and navigate through the requirements interactively

  Scenario: Baseline versions of requirements
    Given a Doorstop project with content
    When I baseline the current version
    Then a new baseline version should be created and stored
```
